types.name: AirdropPayment
docs: One winner to pay: their place in the approved list, wallet, amount, and Merkle proof.

types.name: AirdropRound
docs: One airdrop's approved winner list. The admin approves the list's Merkle root (`approve_airdrop`);
the payout key can then pay each winner exactly their listed amount, once, into their own USDC
account, and nothing else (`pay_traders`).

fields.name: root
docs: Merkle root of the winners: leaf i = sha256(0x00, "float-airdrop", round, i, wallet, amount).

fields.name: total
docs: Sum of every winner's amount, in raw rewards-token units.

fields.name: closed
docs: Cancelled by the admin: nothing more can be paid from this list.

fields.name: paid_bits
docs: Bit i set once winner i has been paid.

fields.name: treasury
docs: Receives ticker takeover fees (SOL) and the treasury share of trading fees.

fields.name: tier_fee_rates
docs: Our fee on every curve trade for each tier a creator can pick (on top of Raydium's own
0.25%), in LaunchLab units (10_000 = 1%). Tier 0 is the default.

fields.name: platforms
docs: Each tier's LaunchLab PlatformConfig, created by `create_platform` with that tier's
platform PDA as admin and fee wallet. Default until created.

fields.name: flagship_mint
docs: Token the flagship vault buys and burns. Default (unset) until the flagship exists.

fields.name: ticker_protect_secs
docs: Takeovers are refused for this long after a ticker is claimed.

fields.name: coin_supply
docs: Total coin supply in raw units.

fields.name: curve_sell_bps
docs: Share of the supply sold on the LaunchLab curve; the rest moves into the Raydium pool at
graduation. It fixes the curve's shape: coins graduate at (f / (1 - f))^2 times their
launch FDV, and keep f of Long's depth afterwards (7325 bps graduates at ~7.5x).

fields.name: launches_paused
docs: Only stops new launches; existing coins keep trading and paying fees.

fields.name: distributor
docs: Key of the payout bot, the only signer `pay_holders` accepts. Rotatable even when frozen.

fields.name: pending_admin
docs: Proposed next admin (e.g. a multisig); takes over once it calls `accept_admin`. Default if none.

fields.name: pending_distributor
docs: After freeze, a newly set payout key waits here until `distributor_ready_at`.

fields.name: rewards_mint
docs: Token the trader rewards vault ends in and pays out (USDC); its swaps must lead to it.

fields.name: traders_paid
docs: Lifetime trader rewards paid out by `pay_traders`, in `rewards_mint` raw units.

fields.name: flagship_burned
docs: Lifetime flagship tokens bought back and burned by the flagship vault.

fields.name: frozen
docs: Once set, fees, flagship, swap guard, supply, curve and ticker rules can never change
again, and existing swap hops can't be rerouted.

fields.name: tier_fee_rates
docs: Our fee per tier (on top of Raydium's 0.25%), in LaunchLab units; tier 0 is the default.

fields.name: rewards_mint
docs: Token the trader rewards vault ends in and pays out (USDC). Default until set.

types.name: FeeSplit
docs: How our trading fee is divided, in bps. The coin's own shares (holders + dev) are collected
by LaunchLab as its creator fee into the coin's PDA; the platform shares (flagship, traders,
treasury) as our platform fee.

fields.name: holders_bps
docs: Paid pro rata to the coin's holders, in the stock token it trades against.

fields.name: dev_bps
docs: Paid to the coin's dev (its fee receiver).

fields.name: flagship_bps
docs: Swapped into the flagship token and burned.

fields.name: traders_bps
docs: Trader rewards vault, paid out by trading volume.

types.name: FeeStats
docs: Where a stock token's fees have gone over its lifetime, in its raw units.

fields.name: holders
docs: Added to coins' holder rewards pots.

fields.name: dev
docs: Paid to coins' fee receivers (the dev share).

fields.name: flagship
docs: Sent to the flagship vault for buyback and burn.

fields.name: traders
docs: Sent to the trader rewards (airdrop) vault.

fields.name: holders_paid
docs: Paid out of the pots to holders by `pay_holders`.

fields.name: quote_total
docs: All fees in the stock token (locked LP fees, the pool's creator fee, and the coin-side LP
fees sold into the stock), split five ways.

fields.name: coins_sold
docs: Coin-side LP fees sold into the stock token (0 when too small to sell yet).

fields.name: ticker
docs: A-Z / a-z / 0-9, 1-10 chars, in the creator's case. Also the metadata symbol. The ticker
record is keyed by its uppercase form, so "Pepe" and "PEPE" are the same ticker.

fields.name: fee_receiver
docs: The dev's wallet, paid the dev share of the coin's fees.

fields.name: fee_tier
docs: Fee tier (index into the config's tier rates); 0 is the default 1%.

fields.name: mint_nonce
docs: Picks the coin's mint address for `launch`: (MINT_SEED, creator, nonce), clients use a random
one. `launch_keyed` ignores it (the mint is the keypair that signs).

fields.name: max_takeover
docs: The most this launch agrees to pay for a ticker takeover (0 when the ticker looked free). The
fee depends on how recently the ticker was claimed, and another launch taking it over first
makes it new again, so the launch fails rather than charge more than the creator was shown.
Optional: launches built without it (earlier tools) end before it and accept any fee.

fields.name: fee_receiver
docs: The dev's wallet, paid the dev share (a wallet, or a pre-generated wallet for an X handle).

fields.name: pool
docs: LaunchLab pool (bonding curve); its Raydium CPMM pool takes over at graduation.

fields.name: fee_tier
docs: Fee tier the creator picked (index into `Config::tier_fee_rates`).

fields.name: coin_fees_claimed
docs: Lifetime coin fees claimed (holders + dev shares), in raw stock-token units.

fields.name: holder_rewards
docs: Lifetime holders share added to the coin PDA's rewards pot, in raw stock-token units.

fields.name: holder_rewards_paid
docs: Lifetime amount paid out of the rewards pot to holders by `pay_holders`.

fields.name: dev_owed
docs: Dev share claimed but not yet sent to the fee receiver (`claim_dev_fees` sends it). It sits in
the coin PDA's stock account next to the holders' pot and can never be paid to holders.

types.name: ListedPair
docs: Marks a pair the lister added: those are the ones the site and bots pick up by themselves.

types.name: Lister
docs: Names the key that can add new pairs (`list_pair`). Default means none.

types.name: MaxTakeover
docs: The most a launch agrees to pay for a ticker takeover. Optional on the wire: launches built before it
existed end without it and agree to any fee (none), so tools made for the earlier launch keep working;
the site sends the price it showed, and a launch fails rather than charge more.

types.name: PlatformBranding
docs: Platform branding shown by LaunchLab-aware apps.

types.name: QuoteAsset
docs: A vetted stock token new coins can be paired against.

fields.name: global_config
docs: Raydium's LaunchLab GlobalConfig for this quote token (constant-product curve).

fields.name: start_fdv
docs: Launch fully-diluted value, in raw units of this stock token.

fields.name: stats
docs: Lifetime fee flows paid in this stock token (the site's analytics totals).

types.name: SwapGuard
docs: Limits on every swap the program makes (the flagship cycle), so a cranker can't sandwich
them: the pool's spot tick must be within `max_deviation_ticks` of its `twap_secs` average
from Raydium's oracle, and one swap may move the price at most `max_impact_bps`. A swap that
hits the limit fills partially; the rest waits for later.

types.name: SwapHop
docs: One allowed step of a vault's route: the flagship vault's to the flagship token (stock -> SOL
-> flagship), the trader rewards vault's to USDC. The vault's whole balance of `input_mint` may
be swapped into `output_mint` through `pool`, and nowhere else.

fields.name: vault
docs: VAULT_FLAGSHIP or VAULT_TRADERS.

fields.name: pool
docs: Raydium pool holding both mints: CLMM (swapped by `cycle`), or CPMM / AMM v4 (`cycle_amm`).

types.name: TickerRecord
docs: Current owner of a ticker. A later launch can take the ticker over by paying the takeover fee.

fields.name: burned
docs: Flagship vault only: flagship tokens burned (its whole flagship balance when this hop ends
there).

constants.name: AIRDROP_SEED
docs: Per-airdrop account (seeds: AIRDROP_SEED, round as u32 little-endian): the winner list the admin
approved, as a Merkle root, and which winners have been paid.

constants.name: COIN_SEED
docs: Per-coin PDA (seeds: COIN_SEED, coin mint) set as the coin's LaunchLab "creator", so the coin's
fee shares (holders + dev) land in a vault only this program can claim. It also holds the
coin's holder rewards pot.

constants.name: LISTED_SEED
docs: Per-token marker (seeds: LISTED_SEED, mint): this pair was added by the lister, so it goes on the live list.

constants.name: LISTER_SEED
docs: The one account naming the lister key (`set_lister`).

constants.name: MINT_SEED
docs: A coin's mint address (seeds: MINT_SEED, creator, LaunchArgs.mint_nonce): this program signs
for it when LaunchLab creates the mint, so the creator's wallet is the launch's only signer.

constants.name: PLATFORM_SEED
docs: System-owned PDA per fee tier (seeds: PLATFORM_SEED, [tier]) that is that tier's LaunchLab
platform admin, fee wallet and LP-NFT wallet, so platforms only change, and platform fees are
only claimed, through this program.

constants.name: TRADERS_VAULT_SEED
docs: Trader rewards vault, paid out by trading volume.
